primitives.name: PROE Allowed

primitives.assumptions: Dropbacks are representative of defensive pass coverage quality.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Mean pass outcome deviation per defense.

layer2.mapping: Quantifies defensive pass protection inefficiency via expected pass outcome deviation.
layer2.telemetry: Average pass outcome variance per defense.
